name: sipyourdrink
description: Claude Code plugins from Alex Chernysh

plugins.name: segue
plugins.description: Compaction that continues without a break: a handoff card before /compact and auto-compact, the summary on Haiku, an instruction to carry on from the card; the same card under Codex CLI.

plugins.name: rm-guard
plugins.description: Refuses rm with recursive and force flags in a Bash command, including inside wrappers, sh -c, eval and substitutions.

plugins.name: audit-log
plugins.description: One JSON line per finished tool call in a private daily file; no tool output, file bodies as sizes, credentials masked.
